blocks.text: A product launch requires parallel sign-off from Engineering (feature complete with no open P0 bugs), Legal (IP clearance and privacy review complete), and Marketing (all launch materials approved).
All three approvals — Engineering, Legal, and Marketing — must be obtained before the launch date is confirmed and communicated externally.

If Legal identifies an unresolved IP issue, the launch is delayed until the issue is cleared by Legal. If Engineering reports open P0 bugs at the time of sign-off, the launch is delayed until all P0 bugs are resolved.
Launch materials must be finalized and submitted for Marketing approval at least 5 business days before the planned launch date.

messages.text: Brand update: per the new brand guidelines, all launch materials now require a final review by the Brand Design team before Marketing sign-off. This is being added as a gate in the launch checklist.
